data.body: Obsoleted by a corrected epic architecture: research (see epic pink-complex-xenurine session log) established that findings.py's shared SEVERITIES/normalize_finding/Finding.severity vocabulary is used by a completion-verification module cluster (completion_reconcile.py, completion_child_gate.py, epic_bug_screen.py, etc.) with no priority/decision alternative -- so ticket byzantine-spinelike-penguin (drop severity field) has been rescoped to NOT remove findings.py's shared severity vocabulary at all; only the review-kernel (pass3_decide) stops stamping severity onto its own findings. Since spec_scan.py's `_severity_rank` reads the shared, still-present severity field, it is never broken by this epic and needs no migration. Closing as obsolete.
